name: Nutanix

Site Reliability Engineer.dsaDepth: Moderate — a core-CS-fundamentals OA (OS, networking, aptitude) then resume-driven technical rounds and an HR round
rounds: Round 1 — Online assessment: core CS concepts (OS, computer networks) plus general aptitude
Technical Round 1: resume-based and scenario-based questions
Technical Round 2: follow-ups probing weaknesses identified in Round 1
HR round: company fit and culture
extraTopics: Deep theory knowledge of virtualization, Linux commands, OS concepts and networking — SREs are client-facing and troubleshoot these areas directly
CPU scheduling algorithms and similar OS fundamentals came up explicitly in one report
Site Reliability Engineer.notes: Reported end-to-end process length is about 1 month.
